reports.title: Hotel Dos Continentes partially collapses in Penonomé
reports.summary: Video posted by La Prensa shows part of the Hotel Dos Continentes on the Interamericana highway collapsed after the quake. The collapse is also reported by Crítica, La Estrella, TVN and El Siglo.

reports.title: San Juan Bautista cathedral tower damaged in Penonomé
reports.summary: Photo shows damage to the Parroquia/Catedral San Juan Bautista. Local media report that its right bell tower partly fell.

reports.title: Penonomé governor's office and cathedral heavily damaged
reports.summary: A journalist's photos and video from Penonomé show the provincial Gobernación building and the cathedral badly damaged, with debris in the street.

reports.title: Crítica photos: Penonomé cathedral and Gobernación
reports.summary: Crítica posted photos and videos of the damaged cathedral and Gobernación in Penonomé.

reports.title: Damage at Iguana Mall, Penonomé
reports.summary: Photo shows damage inside the Iguana Mall shopping centre in Penonomé. Wikipedia describes it as minor damage.

reports.title: Video of damaged Gobernación building in Penonomé
reports.summary: Video shows the Coclé Gobernación building in Penonomé after the quake. Local media report that a wall collapsed.

reports.title: User video: heavy damage in Penonomé city centre
reports.summary: A user posted a video and photo of what they describe as heavy damage to structures in Penonomé.

reports.title: Hotel 2 Continentes: building section down, cars in rubble
reports.summary: Video shows part of the Hotel Dos Continentes collapsed, with cars among the debris.

reports.title: One injured at Penonomé public market; hospital evacuated
reports.summary: El Siglo reports one person injured at the Penonomé Public Market, which was also damaged. It also reports cracks at the San Antonio chapel and at Hospital Aquilino Tejeira, where patients and newborns were evacuated.

reports.title: La Estrella: church tower and hotel damaged in Penonomé
reports.summary: La Estrella de Panamá reports the right tower of the Catholic church fell and the Dos Continentes hotel was reported collapsed. The lead photo is a WhatsApp image of the damage.

reports.title: TVN: hotel, church and Gobernación buildings collapse in Penonomé
reports.summary: TVN reports structural collapses at a hotel, the church and the Gobernación in Penonomé.

reports.title: Cambutal (Tonosí): structural and road damage near the epicentre
reports.summary: Telemetro photo from the Cambutal area on the Azuero coast. Telemetro calls this the most affected area, with damage to structures and roads.

reports.title: Road to Torio (Mariato) split by deep cracks
reports.summary: Photos show the Torio road in Mariato, Veraguas, cracked across its full width with large vertical offsets. Panamá América says the Santiago–Arenas road is 'split in two'.

reports.title: La Prensa image of damaged street to Torio, Mariato
reports.summary: La Prensa photo of the cracked road that leads to Torio, Mariato district, Veraguas.

reports.title: ADN: severe road damage after quake (Tráfico CPanamá photos)
reports.summary: ADN Noticias shared three photos credited to @traficocpanama showing badly cracked and offset asphalt. They appear to be the Torio/Mariato road.

reports.title: Hostal El Sitio collapses at Playa Venao; people reportedly trapped
reports.summary: Video of the damaged El Sitio hostel at Playa Venao (Pedasí). Locals told La Prensa that people were trapped. This is not yet confirmed; Telemetro reports that affected tourist buildings in Pedasí were unoccupied.

reports.title: Collapsed hotel at Playa Venao (user video)
reports.summary: A user video shows a collapsed hotel at Playa Venao. Sinaproc director Omar Smith also named Venao among the areas with preliminary damage.

reports.title: Soná fire station damaged
reports.summary: Telemetro photos show damage to the Mayor Alberto Martinelli fire station in Soná, Veraguas. Panamá América also reports the damage.

reports.title: Ex-president Martinelli posts damage to his house in Soná
reports.summary: Former president Ricardo Martinelli posted photos of his heavily damaged house in Soná and said the losses were material only. Reported by Mi Diario and La Nación. Martinelli said he hoped the losses were only material.

reports.title: Santiago cathedral and municipal building damaged; roof partly collapsed
reports.summary: TVN reports fragments fell from the Santiago cathedral entrance and the municipal building had a partial roof and facade collapse; a bust fell. Central Avenue was closed for inspections.

reports.title: Santiago transport terminal and Policlínica Horacio Díaz Gómez damaged
reports.summary: Panamá América reports structural damage at the Santiago bus terminal and at the Horacio Díaz Gómez polyclinic. No photo is available.

reports.title: Live sports broadcast in Santiago interrupted by quake
reports.summary: RPC sports programme broadcasting live from Santiago (about 60 km from the epicentre) shows the studio shaking violently.

reports.title: Part of Atalaya Basilica tower falls
reports.summary: Panamá América and La Prensa report that part of the tower of the Minor Basilica (Jesús Nazareno) in Atalaya, Veraguas, fell.

reports.title: Cracks in bell tower of historic San Atanasio church, La Villa de Los Santos
reports.summary: Panamá América reports cracks in the bell tower of the colonial San Atanasio church, a national heritage site.

reports.title: Sinaproc: preliminary damage reported in Chitré
reports.summary: Sinaproc director Omar Smith said there was preliminary damage in Chitré and Venao, with other points still being verified. No details or images yet.

reports.title: Evacuations on Calle 50; falling glass in Panama City
reports.summary: Video of mass evacuation on Calle 50. La Prensa reports glass falling from windows of buildings in Calle 50, Paitilla and other commercial areas.

reports.title: Damage reported in Marbella sector, Panama City
reports.summary: Salvadoran outlet CronioSV posted video it says shows damage in the Marbella sector of Panama City. Not confirmed by Panamanian authorities.

reports.title: Chilibre water treatment plant at 20% capacity
reports.summary: IDAAN says the Chilibre water treatment plant is running at 20% capacity after the quake, causing irregular water supply in the capital. No image.

reports.title: Tocumen International Airport suspends operations
reports.summary: Tocumen airport suspended flights and evacuated passengers as a precaution to inspect runways and facilities.

reports.title: Mobile network outages reported after quake
reports.summary: An account reports that several mobile carriers in Panama had outages after the quake. Communication interruptions were also mentioned by Sinaproc.

reports.title: Puente Centenario filmed swaying during quake
reports.summary: Video shows the Centennial Bridge over the Panama Canal during the shaking. No damage is reported.

reports.title: Hospital Santo Tomás staff and patients outside after quake
reports.summary: An AFP photo, used by El Espectador, shows a nurse outside the maternity ward of Santo Tomás hospital in Panama City after the quake.

reports.title: Albrook bus terminal during the quake
reports.summary: Video from inside the Albrook Terminal in Panama City shows violent shaking and people running.

reports.title: Instagram: road surface cracked open in Coclé (Pulzo)
reports.summary: Pulzo Instagram reel shows asphalt split open by the quake. Pulzo locates it in Coclé province, but it may be the Torio (Veraguas) road. The location is unverified.
